#### 1. myopathy, distal, 7, adult-onset, X-linked  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.717)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:11122)

**Proposed mechanism:** SMPX (HGNC:11122) —DISRUPTS→ Muscle fiber maintenance and integrity (GO:0008039); Muscle fiber maintenance and integrity (GO:0008039) —LEADS_TO→ Muscle weakness (HP:0001324); Muscle fiber maintenance and integrity (GO:0008039) —LEADS_TO→ Distal muscle weakness (HP:0008967).
